description: Election Commission -Presidential Election  2024 -Presidential Elections Act. No 15 of 1981 Order Under Section 2
reasoning: This gazette content specifically announces the schedule for the 2024 Presidential Election, including the date of nomination (15th August 2024), the place of nomination, and the polling date (21st September 2024). It is issued by the Election Commission under the Presidential Elections Act and references constitutional provisions regarding presidential elections. This fits perfectly under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral processes, election announcements, and scheduling.
